problem: Powerhouse policies required shared context, chat-learning preflight, control-plane binding and universal completion, but a canonical operation binding alone did not prove that the current material run actually executed the latest preflight before mutation.
impact: Chats and agents could appear governed at repository/control-plane level while users observed little behavioral difference, because policy presence and runtime consumption were not the same evidence class.
rootCause: Preflight and completion were independently mandatory contracts without one identity-bound runtime receipt connecting preflight, mutation admission and postflight completion.
failedApproach: Treating broad policy scope, PR-time preflight CI or database operation binding as sufficient proof that every live material execution had consumed current Powerhouse learning.
fix: Use one Powerhouse universal runtime ingress receipt created from the canonical READY chat-learning preflight, bind it to run/actor/candidate identity, require it before Agent Fabric material commands, and require exact run/candidate continuity again at universal completion.
prevention: A material Powerhouse-managed execution without a valid ADMITTED ingress receipt is not execution-ready evidence. A terminal completion with another run/candidate receipt is invalid. Read-only queries may remain outside the mutation admission path.

delivery_recovery.state_before_recovery: recoverable incomplete execution; PR #1959 had previously passed substantive ingress checks but main advanced and the candidate had to be rebased without broadening scope
delivery_recovery.canonical_candidate_rule: Preserve one delivery lineage and one exact candidate. Rebase the same 10-file universal-ingress scope onto current main rather than opening a parallel implementation path.

admission_failure.symptom: The new Powerhouse delivery-hygiene admission job failed before expensive CI lanes even though the source change itself was valid.
admission_failure.root_cause: PR #1959 did not yet contain the mandatory delivery metadata introduced on newer main.
admission_failure.fix: Add the exact canonical PR metadata without changing code or candidate SHA: Obligation-ID, Delivery-Lane, Candidate-Type, Base-SHA and Supersedes.
admission_failure.result: The same exact candidate was re-admitted; hygiene/admission became green and the protected required lanes continued.
admission_failure.prevention: Every future material or learning/writeback PR must read the current delivery-hygiene contract before admission and include the required metadata from the start. A metadata admission failure is a delivery-contract failure, not a reason to fork a new implementation lineage.

boundary: Repository code cannot alter the native ChatGPT product runtime. The enforceable invariant is that any material Powerhouse mutation invoked from such a chat must cross the managed ingress/control-plane before mutation.
reuse_rule: Future agent/chat runtime work must distinguish policy presence, preflight execution proof, mutation admission proof and terminal completion proof; never infer one from another. Preserve one canonical candidate lineage; when main advances, rebase or reconstruct the exact scoped candidate on current main, satisfy current delivery-hygiene metadata, rerun exact-head protected gates, merge with expected-head identity, read back main, and only then assign LIVE & BEWEZEN. Canonical learning writeback must itself be protected, merged and read back on a later main state; once that persistence proof exists, treat repeated 'borg de borging' requests as idempotent unless material evidence or policy changed.

writeback_verification.later_main_context: PR #1989 subsequently made chats and agents intrinsic Powerhouse loop nodes; this learning record remained present on main after that reinforcement.
writeback_verification.learned_rule: Definition of Done for material learning includes protected writeback plus later-main readback. A learning record is not merely 'written' when it exists on a feature branch or open PR.
writeback_verification.recursive_writeback_rule: Once a canonical learning record has protected-merge evidence and later-main persistence proof, do not create further meta-writebacks solely to prove that proof. Reopen only when material evidence, behavior, contract, root cause or prevention changes.
